page_title: LEE 2-2 BOU | Leeds v Bournemouth 27/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.

90+3' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) scores with a brilliant shot into the right side of the goal after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Marcos Senesi. The score is 2:2.
90+2' We are about to witness a subsitution. Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) for Dominic Calvert-Lewin.
90+2' The whistle blows and Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) is booked for an infringement.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) serves up a nice cross, but Karl Darlow punches the ball away.
87' Substitution. Brenden Aaronson did his best and is replaced by Ao Tanaka (Leeds).
86' The resulting corner from Sean Longstaff (Leeds) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
85' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) was waiting for the ball on the penalty spot and produced a powerful volley goalwards, but the goalkeeper made an amazing save to deny him.
85' 8:4 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
81' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Tyler Adams and he is replaced by Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth).
81' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
80' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by David Brooks (Bournemouth), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
79' Pascal Struijk (Leeds) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
78' There's an opportunity for Sean Longstaff (Leeds) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
78' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Leeds can continue in their attacking effort.
77' Bafode Diakite (Bournemouth) makes a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Leeds, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
76' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

75' A fine solo run by Jack Harrison (Leeds) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
73' Substitution. Alejandro Jimenez leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ben Doak (Bournemouth).
72' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Michael Oliver saw the whole situation. Bournemouth are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
70' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
70' The goalkeeper dives to deny Jack Harrison (Leeds), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
70' A great solo run by David Brooks (Bournemouth) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the right side of the goal was easily caught by Karl Darlow.
69' Bournemouth enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
67' Noah Okafor has picked up an injury and is replaced by Jack Harrison (Leeds).
65' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
62' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Leeds.
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and David Brooks (Bournemouth) comes onto the pitch so that Amine Adli can be given a rest.
60' Andoni Iraola decides to make a substitution. Justin Kluivert will be replaced by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth).
60' Substitution. Alex Scott (Bournemouth) has come on for Ryan Christie.
59' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.

54' 2 - 1 Sean Longstaff (Leeds) is in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound and unleashes a fabulous shot from just outside the box. He couldn't be more precise. His effort bounces off the right post and into the back of the net. Absolutely fantastic!
54' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
53' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Leeds comes to nothing.
53' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Good work from Leeds as they win a corner.
50' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
48' A clumsy foul by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) and Michael Oliver blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Leeds.
46' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
43' Michael Oliver blows the whistle, Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) is penalised for a foul. Leeds will take a free kick near the side line.

40' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Karl Darlow has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.

38' 1 - 1 Joe Rodon (Leeds) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Sean Longstaff. His header was precise and ended up inside the left post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 1:1.
37' Sean Longstaff (Leeds) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
37' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Leeds. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Leeds.
34' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Jayden Bogle (Leeds) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
33' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
32' Noah Okafor (Leeds) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
31' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and signals a foul after Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) brought his opponent down. A free kick to Leeds.
26' 0 - 1 Wonderful finish from Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth). He drills a low shot precisely into the bottom left corner. No chance for the goalkeeper.
25' Michael Oliver blows his whistle. Anton Stach (Leeds) commits a foul after dangerous play. Bournemouth win a free kick.
23' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
23' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
22' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Bournemouth will take a corner kick.
20' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
19' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him.
18' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom left corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Djordje Petrovic. What a save!
17' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
16' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) tackles a bit over-zealously and Michael Oliver blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Leeds in a dangerous position.
13' A cross from Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
12' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) picks up a yellow card.
12' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth). Michael Oliver saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Leeds earn a free kick.
10' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) sends a cross into the box, but Karl Darlow comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Leeds will have a goal kick.
6' That's a well-taken pass by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
6' Bournemouth take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
6' A lofted cross from Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Bournemouth get a corner.
4' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) sends a long ball in, but Karl Darlow comfortably gathers the ball.
3' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) trips an opposition player and Michael Oliver signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Bournemouth.
3' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) brings an opponent down and Michael Oliver interrupts the game. Leeds have a free kick.
1' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Leeds will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Michael Oliver.
